source.title: Variants in LRRC7 lead to intellectual disability, autism, aggression and abnormal eating behaviors
source.quote: We identify here 33 individuals (one of them previously described) with a dominant neurodevelopmental disorder due to heterozygous missense or loss-of-function variants in LRRC7.
